body:
erin: Quick design review: proposing a "welcome chip" that sits to the left of the workspace header for brand-new users. Chip shows icon + short label (e.g. 'Welcome: Start') and expands to a 3-step micro-panel on click. Persistent for 3 sessions, then auto-collapses. Thoughts?
sam: Nice unobtrusive placement. Concern: current mock uses 12px text on medium gray; fails WCAG for small text. Increase to 14px and higher contrast.
lucy: Accessibility: focusable, has clear focus ring, aria-expanded on the chip, and when a step completes we should update an aria-live region (polite). Also add non-color state (icons/checks).
kai: Dismissal rules: soft dismiss for 7 days on close; permanent opt-out only via explicit "Don't show again". Respect org admin setting to disable onboarding. Also avoid telemetry unless user opts in.
serin: UX question: expand on hover for desktop? Maybe hover shows brief tooltip, click expands. Mobile: tap to expand to a bottom sheet. Ensure tap targets >=44px.
sam: Copy variants to test: A) "Welcome — Start your first project" B) "Get started (3 quick steps)". I prefer A for tone. Track metrics: welcome_chip_impression, chip_expand, step_complete, chip_dismiss.
ux-bot: Experiment created: welcome_chip_copy_A vs welcome_chip_copy_B. Funnel: chip_expand -> step_1_complete -> onboard_done.
lucy: Tiny nit: the close button needs aria-label="Dismiss welcome panel" and should announce when dismissed. Provide restore path via Help > Reopen onboarding.
erin: I'll update Figma with high-contrast styles, keyboard flows, and mobile sheet. Posting frames in #design later today and scheduling a short usability check next week. Thanks! :sparkles:
